thesis.raw_input: Robinhood can sustain growth because revenue is expanding and direct competition remains limited.
key_assumptions: revenue and earnings continue to grow
negative_signals: a large platform launches a competing product

focus_points: verify revenue growth and competitor entry

documents.title: Robinhood shares decline in afternoon trading
documents.content: Robinhood shares fell 6 percent during the session as technology stocks traded lower. The report did not discuss operating results or competitors.

documents.title: Robinhood reports higher revenue and earnings
documents.content: Robinhood reported that quarterly revenue increased 45 percent year over year while net income more than doubled. Subscription revenue and transaction-based revenue both expanded.

documents.title: Meta develops a rival prediction-markets app
documents.content: Meta Platforms is developing a competing prediction-markets application. A launch would introduce a large consumer platform as a direct rival to Robinhood's event-contract business.

documents.title: Robinhood leases additional office space
documents.content: The company signed a lease for renovated office space and plans to move several administrative teams next year.

thesis.raw_input: NVIDIA benefits from sustained hyperscaler AI capital spending, but custom accelerator competition could weaken its share.
thesis.main_thesis: NVIDIA benefits from continued AI infrastructure investment
key_assumptions: hyperscaler AI capital expenditure keeps growing
NVIDIA retains share against custom ASICs
positive_signals: cloud customers raise AI infrastructure budgets

documents.title: NVIDIA completes stock split
documents.content: NVIDIA completed a ten-for-one stock split. The transaction changed the share count but did not change the company's market value or demand outlook.

documents.title: Cloud customer AI infrastructure commitments expand
documents.content: Management reported multi-year purchase commitments from major cloud service providers and said customers increased capital expenditure budgets for accelerated computing infrastructure.

documents.title: Cloud companies expand custom AI accelerator deployments
documents.content: Two hyperscalers plan wider deployment of internally designed custom ASIC accelerators. The programs could substitute for some NVIDIA GPU workloads and create pricing pressure.

documents.title: Gaming graphics card channel inventory
documents.content: Gaming channel inventory returned to normal levels after holiday promotions. The filing did not quantify cloud infrastructure investment.

thesis.raw_input: Tesla's valuation depends on automotive margin recovery and timely regulatory approval for a commercial robotaxi service.
thesis.main_thesis: Tesla margins recover as robotaxi commercialization advances

documents.title: Tesla shares move after delivery report
documents.content: Tesla shares gained during trading after quarterly vehicle deliveries were published. Analysts changed their price targets.

documents.title: Automotive gross margin contracts despite lower battery cost
documents.content: Automotive gross margin excluding regulatory credits fell to 14.2 percent from 17.1 percent a year earlier. Battery input costs declined, but vehicle price reductions more than offset those savings.

documents.title: Regulator delays Tesla commercial robotaxi permit
documents.content: The state regulator postponed a decision on Tesla's permit for paid driverless robotaxi service and requested additional safety data. Testing may continue, but commercial rides remain unauthorized.

documents.title: Energy storage deployments reach a record
documents.content: Energy storage deployments reached a quarterly record as Megapack production increased at the California factory.

thesis.raw_input: Eli Lilly can capture growing obesity demand if manufacturing capacity expands faster than competing therapies.
thesis.main_thesis: Eli Lilly captures expanding obesity-treatment demand
key_assumptions: GLP-1 demand remains strong and supply capacity expands
competing therapies do not erode share
positive_signals: new production lines increase available doses
negative_signals: a rival obesity drug shows superior efficacy

documents.title: Eli Lilly declares quarterly dividend
documents.content: The board declared a regular quarterly cash dividend payable to shareholders of record next month.

documents.title: New production lines lift injectable medicine capacity
documents.content: Eli Lilly said two new manufacturing lines began production, increasing available GLP-1 doses by 35 percent. Prescription demand continued to exceed supply during the quarter.

documents.title: Rival obesity medicine reports strong phase-three results
documents.content: A competing obesity therapy achieved greater average weight loss than the current market leader in a phase-three study. If approved, the rival could pressure Eli Lilly's market share.

documents.title: Administrative office lease renewal
documents.content: The company renewed an administrative office lease for five years under terms similar to the previous agreement.

documents.content: JPMorgan plans to open twelve retail branches in growing metropolitan areas over the next two years.

documents.title: Net interest income outlook falls while card charge-offs rise
documents.content: JPMorgan lowered net interest income guidance as deposit costs remained elevated. The credit-card net charge-off rate increased to 3.6 percent, near the upper end of management guidance.

documents.title: Federal Reserve projects additional policy-rate cuts
documents.content: The Federal Reserve's updated projections indicate two additional policy-rate cuts. Lower short-term rates can compress bank asset yields and net interest margins.

documents.title: Headline consumer inflation moderates
documents.content: Headline consumer price inflation moderated because gasoline prices declined. The release did not discuss bank margins or consumer loan performance.
